verse_of_the_day.text: A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or a gold.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine winning a hundred boxes full of diamonds and gold! That would make you super rich. But God says that being a good person, someone who is known for being kind and honest, is actually way better than winning all that gold. Getting a great reputation as a kind friend is the best treasure you can ever collect.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, thank You for making my heart a treasure chest. Help me to care more about being kind and honest than having cool toys. Help me to build an awesome reputation today. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Ask a parent or a close friend what word they would use to describe you. When they say a nice word, thank God for helping you build a good name!

verse_of_the_day.text: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: The Bible isn't just a regular, boring book. It is actually 'God-breathed'! That means God put His power and truth into every single word. When you read the Bible, it is like sitting down with a superhero coach who trains your heart and helps you run the race of life perfectly.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, thank You for giving me the Bible. Let Your powerful, God-breathed words fill my heart today. Teach me how to run my race in the very best way. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Before you read your verse tomorrow morning, take a giant deep breath. Let it remind you that the words you are reading were breathed by God!

verse_of_the_day.text: He will not let your foot slip—he who watches over you will not slumber.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Have you ever tried to climb up an icy hill in slippery shoes? It feels like you could tumble down at any second! God is like wearing super-sturdy snow boots with spikes. He grabs onto you and doesn't let your feet slip. Best of all, He never gets tired or falls asleep while He is watching over you.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, thank You for holding onto me so tightly. When my path feels slippery, keep my feet perfectly safe. Thank You that You never fall asleep when I need You. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Put on your favorite pair of shoes today. As you tie them, say: 'God keeps my feet from slipping!'

verse_of_the_day.text: If you declare with your mouth, 'Jesus is Lord,' and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Getting into heaven isn't a secret puzzle you have to solve, and you don't have to be perfect to earn a ticket. It is actually super simple! All you have to do is truly believe in your heart that Jesus is the powerful King who defeated death, and tell Him you want to follow Him.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Father, I believe that Jesus is my King! I believe He is super powerful and defeated death. Thank You for saving me and giving me a place in Your family. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Stand in front of a mirror, point to yourself, and shout out loud: 'Jesus is my King!'

verse_of_the_day.text: You, my brothers and sisters, were called to be free. But do not use your freedom to indulge the flesh; rather, serve one another humbly in love.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine you got a magic ticket that let you do whatever you wanted all day long! You could eat 100 donuts and play video games non-stop. But God tells us that true freedom isn't just about being selfish. True freedom is using your amazing choices to help others and make them feel super loved.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, thank You for making me totally free. Instead of using my choices to be selfish today, help me to serve my family and friends with an awesome, humble heart. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Use your freedom to do one super nice thing for a sibling or parent today, like putting away their shoes or grabbing them a snack.

verse_of_the_day.text: I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: When something totally awesome happens—like finding a ten dollar bill or scoring a goal—you run and tell everyone! God wants us to be just as excited about Him. When we say thank you, we should shout out all the wonderful things He has done so everyone else knows how amazing He is!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, I am so thankful for You! Help me to tell all my friends and family about the wonderful things You have done for me. Give me a big, happy heart today. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Tell one person today about something awesome God has done for you. It could be big or small!

verse_of_the_day.text: As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine a dull, rusty sword. If you rub it against another strong piece of iron, the sparks fly, and the sword becomes super sharp and shiny! Good friends do that for us. When we hang out with friends who love God, they challenge us to be better and 'sharpen' our hearts to be strong and bright.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, thank You for the good friends in my life. Help us to be like iron sharpening iron. Let us help each other grow stronger and better every single day. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Think of a friend who helps you be a better person. Send them a quick message or tell them in person: 'Thanks for making me sharper!'

verse_of_the_day.text: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moths and vermin do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: If you bury a shiny toy in the dirt, eventually it will get rusty and break. Earthly stuff doesn't last forever! But when you collect 'heavenly treasures'—like loving people, forgiving your friends, and obeying God—those treasures get locked up in God's totally unbreakable vault. They will be yours forever!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Father, I know my toys won't last forever. Help me to focus on collecting heavenly treasures today. Teach me how to store up things like love, kindness, and obedience. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Draw a picture of an unbreakable vault. Write the word 'Love' inside it as your first heavenly treasure!

verse_of_the_day.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: If you get on an airplane and fly East, you will just keep flying East forever; you will never suddenly bump into the West! That is exactly how far God throws our mistakes away. When He forgives you, He tosses your sins so incredibly far away that they can never, ever find you again.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, Your forgiveness is mind-blowing! Thank You for throwing my mistakes as far away as the East is from the West. Help me to feel totally clean today. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Take a piece of scrap paper, write 'My Mistakes' on it, crumple it up, and throw it as far away from you as you can! Say, 'God threw them even further!'

verse_of_the_day.text: I press on toward the goal to win the prize for which God has called me heavenward in Christ Jesus.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Life is like a totally epic footrace, and you are running straight toward the coolest finish line ever! Sometimes you might feel tired or want to quit, but you have to keep your eyes locked on the prize. Keep running super fast toward Jesus, because the prize He has waiting for you in heaven is unbelievable.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, give me fast running shoes today! When I get tired, help me to keep my eyes on the awesome prize You have waiting for me. I want to run my race for You. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Next time you are outside, mark a finish line in the grass and run toward it as fast as you can! When you cross it, shout, 'I am running for Jesus!'

verse_of_the_day.text: Let us then approach God’s throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine a massive, shining throne room with the King of the Universe sitting in the middle. Most people would be too scared to go inside! But God gives us a VIP pass. He says we can walk right up to His giant throne with total confidence, knowing He will give us a giant hug and give us whatever help we need.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, thank You that I am allowed to walk right up to Your throne. Give me the confidence to come to You whenever I need help, knowing You are happy to see me! Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Pretend your favorite chair is God's throne today. Walk up to it with a big, confident smile, and then bow down and say a quick prayer.

verse_of_the_day.text: Even small children are known by their actions, so is their conduct really pure and upright?

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: You don't have to be a grown-up to be totally amazing! Even kids can be known for having an awesome heart. When you tell the truth, share your toys, and act with kindness, people notice your super-actions. Your awesome conduct proves that you have a pure, shiny heart inside.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Father, I know I am young, but I want my actions to be huge! Help me to be known for having a pure, upright heart that loves You completely. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Make a goal to do one 'super-action' today that proves you have a pure heart, like telling the truth even when it is hard.

verse_of_the_day.text: But in your hearts revere Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give an answer to everyone who asks you to give the reason for the hope that you have.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: If you just rode the coolest rollercoaster ever, you would be super ready to tell all your friends how awesome it was! When you follow Jesus, you have incredible hope inside your heart. God wants you to be ready to tell everyone why you are so happy and hopeful, just like you would tell them about an awesome rollercoaster.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, You fill my heart with so much hope and happiness! Help me to be brave and ready to tell all my friends about You when they ask why I am smiling. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Practice answering this question out loud right now: 'Why do you love Jesus so much?' Be ready with your awesome answer!

verse_of_the_day.text: How can a young person stay on the path of purity? By living according to your word.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine you are hiking on a cool mountain trail, but there are muddy swamps on both sides. How do you stay clean? You follow the trail markers perfectly! The Bible is your map full of trail markers. When you read it and do what it says, you stay right on the safe, pure path and avoid the messy mud!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, thank You for giving me the Bible as my trail map. Help me to read Your words so I can stay on the pure, clean path and not get stuck in the mud. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Draw a winding path on a piece of paper. On the path, write the words 'The Bible keeps me on track!'

verse_of_the_day.text: Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: God is like the coolest, most loving neighbor ever. He says if you want something good, just ask Him! If you are confused, seek Him like a treasure hunt! If you need a new opportunity, just knock on His door! He is always waiting right on the other side, ready to open up and help you out.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, thank You that I can always ask You for help. Give me the courage to knock on Your door today when I need something, knowing You are ready to answer. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Pretend to knock on an invisible door right now. When you do, say out loud, 'I am asking for Your help today, God!'

verse_of_the_day.text: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Have you ever played with a cool Transformer toy? It starts as a car and flips into an awesome robot! God doesn't want you to look exactly like the rest of the world. He wants to 'transform' your brain so you think totally differently. When you read the Bible, He flips your mind from thinking normally to thinking with awesome superhero wisdom!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Father, I don't want to just blend in with the world. Please transform my mind! Give me new, awesome thoughts that help me act like a true superhero for You. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: If you have a transforming toy, play with it today! Let it remind you that God is busy transforming your brain into something amazing.

verse_of_the_day.text: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Wisdom is like having a super-powered brain that always knows the right choice to make. If you are stuck on a hard problem or don't know what to do, you can just ask God! He is incredibly generous, which means He loves to pour out buckets of wisdom over your head without ever making fun of you for asking.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, sometimes I feel confused and I don't know what to do. Please pour a giant bucket of Your wisdom on me! Help my brain to know the right choices today. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Tap the side of your head with your finger and say: 'God, please fill this brain with Your wisdom!'

verse_of_the_day.text: You have searched me, Lord, and you know me.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Did you know God is an expert detective? But instead of solving crimes, He has investigated every single thing about YOU! He knows what makes you laugh, He knows your favorite color, and He even knows what you are thinking before you say it. He knows you perfectly, and He loves everything about you.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, it is so amazing that You are an expert on me! Thank You for knowing every single thing about my heart and for loving me exactly the way I am. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Pretend you have a giant magnifying glass and examine your hand. Remember that God examines you just as closely, and He loves what He sees!

verse_of_the_day.text: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this pleases the Lord.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Obeying your parents isn't just about following boring rules; it is actually a secret way to make God smile a giant smile! When you listen to your mom and dad quickly without arguing, it makes God so incredibly happy. You are proving that you trust the awesome leaders He put in your life.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, I really want to make You smile today. Give me the strength to obey my parents quickly and happily, without any complaining. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: The very next time your parents ask you to do something, say 'Okay!' right away and do it super fast to make God smile!

verse_of_the_day.text: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God’s special possession.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: If you look closely in the mirror, you might just see an invisible crown on your head! Because you follow God, you are part of His royal family. That makes you a prince or a princess of heaven! You are God's super special, chosen possession, and He treasures you more than all the gold in the world.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Father, I cannot believe I am part of Your royal family! Thank You for putting an invisible crown on my head and making me Your special treasure. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Walk around your house with excellent posture today, standing up totally straight and tall like a prince or princess!

verse_of_the_day.text: I seek you with all my heart; do not let me stray from your commands.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Playing hide-and-seek is awesome, but seeking God is the best game ever! When we seek Him 'with all our heart,' it means we are looking for His love everywhere we go. We read our Bible and pray so that we stay completely glued to Him and don't wander off into the muddy parts of life.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, I want to be the best seeker ever! Help me to look for You with my whole entire heart today. Keep me glued to Your amazing rules and promises. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Play a quick round of hide-and-seek today! When you find the hidden person, remember that seeking God is even more fun.

verse_of_the_day.text: The eyes of the Lord are everywhere, keeping watch on the wicked and the good.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: God has the ultimate security camera system! His eyes can see everywhere at the exact same time. He sees when people make bad choices, but even better—He sees every time you make a good choice! Even if you are totally alone in your room and do something kind, God is watching and cheering for you.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, thank You for watching over me everywhere I go. Help me to remember that You always see my choices, and give me the strength to always choose what is good. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Do a completely secret, kind act today when no one else is looking! Know that God’s eyes see it and He is super proud of you.

verse_of_the_day.text: When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, 'I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.'

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: If you try to walk through a pitch-black cave, you will probably bump your head! Jesus is the brightest, most powerful light in the whole world. When you hold onto His hand and follow Him, He shines His glowing 'light of life' right in front of you so you never have to stumble in the dark again.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Jesus, You are the brightest light ever! Thank You for chasing away the darkness in my life. Let Your glowing light guide my steps all day long. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Use a flashlight in a dark room today to read your favorite book. Let it remind you of how Jesus lights up your life!

verse_of_the_day.text: Carry each other’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: If your friend is trying to carry ten heavy backpacks all by themselves, what do you do? You grab five of them to help! A 'burden' is something heavy or sad that someone is carrying in their heart. God wants us to be super strong helpers who walk over, grab a strap, and help carry the heavy stuff for our friends.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, give me strong shoulders today! If my friends or family are feeling sad or carrying heavy burdens, help me to step in and help them carry the load. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Ask someone in your house today: 'Is there anything I can do to help you?' Be ready to jump in and grab one of their backpacks!

verse_of_the_day.text: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Everyone gets afraid sometimes—even big, tough grown-ups! Fear is like an annoying, yapping dog that tries to scare us. But God gives us an amazing defense shield called 'Trust.' The exact second you start feeling afraid, you can push the 'Trust' button and let God chase the scary feelings away.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, sometimes things happen that make me feel scared. When the fear comes today, help me to press my Trust button instantly and run straight to You. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Draw a picture of a giant button that says 'TRUST' on it. Pretend to push it whenever you feel a little nervous today!

verse_of_the_day.text: Jesus replied: 'Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind. This is the first and greatest commandment.'

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: If someone asked you, 'What is the most important rule in the entire universe?', what would you say? Jesus gave us the answer! The absolute number one rule is to love God completely—with every beat of your heart, every thought in your brain, and every ounce of your energy!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Jesus, I want to follow the greatest rule of all! Help me to love You with my whole heart, my whole brain, and all of my energy today. You are my favorite! Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Tap your head, your heart, and your muscles today and say out loud: 'I love God with all my mind, heart, and strength!'

verse_of_the_day.text: Whoever walks in integrity walks securely, but whoever takes crooked paths will be found out.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Walking in 'integrity' means you always tell the truth and don't try to hide bad choices. It is like walking on a wide, flat, super safe sidewalk! But lying and hiding is like trying to walk on a crooked, bumpy path in the dark—eventually, you are going to trip and fall flat on your face.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, I want to be someone who walks in integrity. Keep me off the crooked, bumpy paths of lying. Give me the courage to always tell the truth so I can walk safely! Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Walk with the best posture you can today, holding your head high. Remind yourself that telling the truth lets you walk tall and secure!

verse_of_the_day.text: Dear friends, let us love one another, for love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Think of God like a gigantic, glowing power plant of love. He invented it! When we show love to our friends—like sharing or being patient—we are proving that our hearts are plugged directly into God's super-power plant. If you want everyone to know you belong to God, just show them how much you can love!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, thank You for being the power plant of love. Keep my heart plugged into You all day long! Let me love my friends so well that they can see You living inside me. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Draw a power cord going from your heart up to the sky. Remind yourself that God powers your ability to love people today!

verse_of_the_day.text: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Have you ever tried walking around your house when all the lights are turned off? It's really hard not to stub your toe! The Bible is like a super bright, glowing lantern that you carry right down by your feet. It shines so brightly that you can always see the exact right place to step next.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Father, thank You that I don't have to stumble in the dark. Your Bible is the best lantern ever. Please shine Your light on my path today so I know the right choices to make. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Take a flashlight or a phone light and shine it right by your feet as you take a few steps. That is exactly what God's Word does for your life!

verse_of_the_day.text: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Paul wrote this verse while he was stuck in a dark, yucky prison! But he wasn't complaining. He figured out a secret: You can be totally happy no matter where you are because God's joy lives *inside* you! Paul is cheering for you right now, shouting: 'Celebrate God! Come on, I'll say it again: Celebrate!'

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, You fill me with so much awesome joy! Even if things are tough or boring today, help me to rejoice and celebrate how good You are. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Throw your hands in the air and yell 'Rejoice!' right now. Give yourself a reason to smile and celebrate God's love.
